fixer.title: Reference hover UI improvements addressing post-merge feedback

introducer.title: sessions: add image previews to reference hovers and align all artifact type behavior better

cases.mechanism: Refreshing an open action-list hover invokes the replacement entry's image content factory as a preservation probe. That factory immediately starts a cancellable fileService.readFile of up to 20 MiB; when the new element is not the one already attached, the pre-fix path discarded it without retaining or disposing its preview handle, so the read and subsequent image allocations could continue for every refresh.
cases.symptom: Live session/reference updates while an image row hover is open can leave rejected preview candidates doing unnecessary filesystem/remote-filesystem I/O and retaining their preview resources until completion.
cases.fixedBehavior: The hover descriptor now exposes disposeContent, and ActionListWidget calls it whenever the factory-created preservation candidate is rejected; the image implementation disposes the candidate and cancels its read immediately.
cases.evidence: The base factory at chatDropdownPill.ts:375 creates createChatPillImagePreview on first invocation, whose implementation starts fileService.readFile with a 20 MiB cap. ActionListWidget.updateItems invokes that factory during preserveHover refreshes, and the new RIGHT line 1699 disposes a candidate when preservePanel is false. The added test verifies the rejected replacement token becomes cancelled. The introducing-line blame resolves to the image-preview change 05ffe98d55ba4d22054b6f18366985bd0180d2dc.
